CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTeacherText:
You came from
OLIVINE?

Do you remember
the four islands along the way?

I heard that a 
mythical sea crea- ture is hiding in them.
CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseLassText:
I heard that you
can only see it if

you have a SILVER
WING.

It must have the
same scent as the creature.
CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTwinText:
I've heard that
the whirlpools

around the islands
are caused by the sea creature.

You might need a
special move to get past them.
